summary: This filing is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering by Sonida Senior Living, Inc., filed under Rule 424(b)(5) of the Securities Act of 1933. It allows the issuer to sell up to $250 million of its common stock through multiple sales agents and forward sellers, using forward sale agreements. The offering is a routine capital-raising program, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No specific price, premium, or event-driven catalyst is stated. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special-situation corporate event.
